verdict.rationale: Ashby documents custom agents for repeated workflows in its Assistant. Its AI Notetaker can be rolled out to all interviews with no extra steps, which is a form of autonomous background processing. However, the agents are described as chat-invoked, and nothing shows user-configured triggers, schedules, or unattended background agent runs. Webhooks are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable background or scheduled automations, event-triggered autonomous agent runs, documentation of unattended execution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
